title: Portal and Student Services Help
facts: Academic advisor: assigned from enrollment to graduation; consult before each semester registration
Advisor approves: registration, load changes, add/drop, co-req enrollment
Dept head approves: late registration, co-req, withdrawal
Dean approves: late reg after Week1, withdrawal after Week4, special cases
College Council approves: study interruption, withdrawal after Week12, re-enrollment, dismissal appeals
University Council approves: graduation results, certificates, fee structures
Website: www.nub.edu.eg (calendar, announcements, results)
Admission: General Secondary Certificate (Science stream) or foreign equivalent + medical fitness exam (no infectious diseases)
Transfer from other universities: allowed if min admission score met + Science stream cert + not in graduation year; dept evaluates transfer credits; new academic record created
Transfer from military/police colleges: allowed for non-disciplinary dismissal or exhausted failure attempts; admitted as new student at matching level
Specialization change: before 108cr completed (Junior); requires new dept council + College Council approval; follows new program from approval date; special cases may allow Senior year change
Dismissal from specialization (after 2 sem warning): may transfer to another spec if accepted; else dismissed from college
College dismissal: requires College Council + University President approval; student notified by registered letter
Re-enrollment after dismissal: College Council approval + min 2yr wait; re-admitted as external (practicals only); load excludes prev failed courses; re-enrollment fee applies
Specialization change or re-enrollment: student follows new program regulations from approval year
Special case (non-degree) student: takes specific courses only; cannot complete degree; fees/course limits set by University Council
Visiting students from other universities: may study specific courses at NUB with home institution approval
Graduation certificate: issued after University Council approval; signed by dean; honors recorded if applicable
Departments: CS | IS | IT | DS
College Council: official authority for interpreting regulations
All students responsible for knowing published regulations; ignorance not accepted
